strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Isofthiwe yabathengisi nokuthengisa ngeveni
strings.tierB.home.description: Isofthiwe yabasabalalisi: ama-invoyisi namarisidi efonini yomthengisi, isitoko seveni, izinkokhelo, imizila nokuvakasha. Isebenza noma kungekho nethiwekhi.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Phatha abathengisi bakho kusukela ekuvakasheni kokuqala kuze kube senkokhelweni yokugcina
strings.tierB.home.definition: I-FieldSales iyiplatifomu ye-cloud yokuphatha abathengisi (sales reps) nokuthengisa ngeveni (van sales) ezinkampanini zokusabalalisa nezithengisa ngobuningi. Abathengisi bakhipha futhi baphrinte ama-invoyisi namarisidi kusuka efonini yabo, balandelele isitoko seveni futhi babhale ukuvakasha, kuyilapho abaphathi bebona okuthengisiwe, imali eqoqiwe namabhalansi amakhasimende ngesikhathi kwenzeka.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Ama-invoyisi kusuka efonini yomthengisi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Umthengisi ukhipha i-invoyisi emnyango wekhasimende ayiphrinte ngephrinta ye-thermal esebenza nge-Bluetooth ngaphambi kokuphuma esitolo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Ukuqoqa izinkokhelo namabhalansi amakhasimende
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Inkokhelo ngayinye ithola irisidi elinenombolo elixhunywe kuma-invoyisi akhokhelwayo, futhi ibhalansi yekhasimende nesitatimende sakhe kubuyekezwa ngokushesha.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Isitoko seveni esiphethwe ngumthengisi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Isitoko seveni ngayinye silandelelwa umkhiqizo nomkhiqizo: esilayishiwe, esithengisiwe, esibuyisiwe nesisele, ngakho noma yikuphi ukushoda kubonakala ngalo lolo suku.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Imizila nokuvakasha
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Ukuvakasha ngakunye kubhalwa nendawo, isikhathi nezithombe, futhi umzila womthengisi ngamunye udwetshwa emephini ukuze umphathi awubone.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Abathengisi baqhubeka bethengisa noma kungekho siginali. Amadokhumenti alinda efonini futhi avumelaniswe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngaphandle kokuphindaphindeka, lapho uxhumano lubuya.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Ideshibhodi yewebhu yabaphathi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Okuthengisiwe, imali eqoqiwe, okubuyisiwe, isitoko nokusebenza kwabathengisi endaweni eyodwa, nezindima namalungelo omsebenzisi ngamunye.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Sitshele ukuthi uthengisa kanjani
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Cela ikhotheshini noma ubhuke umhlangano. Sibheka abathengisi bakho, imizila yakho, imikhiqizo yakho nezidingo zakho zama-invoyisi.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Hlela inkampani yakho
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Engeza imikhiqizo, amanani, amakhasimende nabathengisi, bese usetha uhlobo lwemali nezinga lentela lezwe lakho kuzilungiselelo.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Thumela abathengisi emizileni
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Abathengisi bafaka i-app ku-Android noma ku-iPhone, balayishe iveni yabo, baqale ukuthengisa, ukuphrinta nokuqoqa imali.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Landela usuku njengoba lwenzeka
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Ideshibhodi yewebhu ikhombisa okuthengisiwe, imali eqoqiwe, isitoko esisemaveni nokuvakasha ngesikhathi abathengisi besesemizileni.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: I-FieldSales iyiplatifomu ye-cloud yokuphatha abathengisi abavakashela amakhasimende ezinkampanini zokusabalalisa nezithengisa ngobuningi. Ihlanganisa ukuthengisa ngeveni (van sales), ukuthengisa ngemizila (route sales), ukuthatha ama-oda kusengaphambili (pre-sales) nokulethwa ngqo ezitolo (DSD). Abathengisi benza ama-invoyisi, baphrinte, baqoqe imali futhi babhale ukuvakasha kusuka efonini yabo, kanti abaphathi balandela okuthengisiwe, imali eqoqiwe, isitoko esisemaveni namabhalansi amakhasimende kudeshibhodi yewebhu.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Yebo. I-app yabathengisi iqhubeka isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi: abathengisi bakhipha futhi baphrinte ama-invoyisi namarisidi, babhale ukuvakasha futhi bengeze amakhasimende, bese konke kuvumelaniswa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngaphandle kokuphindaphindeka lapho uxhumano lubuya. Kukhona okuhlukile okukodwa eSaudi Arabia: izinkampani ezivule ukuxhumanisa kwama-invoyisi e-elekthronikhi zidinga uxhumano lwe-inthanethi ngesikhathi kukhishwa i-invoyisi noma kubhalwa okubuyisiwe.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: I-FieldSales isebenzela izinkampani zokusabalalisa kuwo wonke amazwe. Inkampani ngayinye isetha uhlobo lwayo lwemali nezinga layo lentela kuzilungiselelo zayo, futhi kusetshenziswa kuma-invoyisi, kumarisidi nasemibikweni. Inkampani ye-FieldSales izinze eRiyadh, eSaudi Arabia, futhi ukuqalisa nosizo kwenziwa ku-inthanethi ngemihlangano nange-WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: Ingabe i-FieldSales ixhumana nezinhlelo zikahulumeni zama-invoyisi e-elekthronikhi?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Sisekela ukuxhumanisa kweSigaba Sesibili neplatifomu ye-Fatoora ye-ZATCA. Lokhu kusebenza ezinkampanini zaseSaudi Arabia. Kwamanye amazwe, i-FieldSales ikhipha ama-invoyisi ngohlobo lwakho lwemali nezinga lakho lentela, futhi ukuxhumanisa nohlelo lukazwelonke lwama-invoyisi e-elekthronikhi (e-invoicing) kuyatholakala uma kuceliwe, ngemva kokuba sihlole izidingo zalelo zwe kanye nawe. Ngaphandle kweSaudi Arabia asenzi sithembiso mayelana nemithetho yendawo.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: I-app ye-FieldSales itholakala kulezi zilimi kuphela: isi-Arabic, i-English, isi-French, isi-Turkish, ne-isi-Chinese. Ayitholakali ngesiZulu. Abathengisi nabaphathi bangashintsha ulimi lwe-app, futhi ama-invoyisi aphrintiwe angaba nolimi lwesibili eceleni kolimi oluyinhloko. Amakhasi ewebhusayithi ngezinye izilimi, njengaleli khasi lesiZulu, ayizinguqulo ezinikeza ulwazi ngomkhiqizo.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Cela ikhotheshini, bhuka umhlangano noma usithumelele umlayezo ku-WhatsApp. Sifunda ukuthi abathengisi bakho basebenza kanjani, bese sikusiza ukuhlela imikhiqizo, amanani, amakhasimende nabathengisi. Abathengisi bafaka i-app ku-Android noma ku-iPhone, futhi abaphathi basebenzisa ideshibhodi yewebhu kunoma yisiphi isiphequluli. Udinga ama-smartphone kuphela; awudingi eminye imishini.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: I-app ye-FieldSales itholakala kulezi zilimi: isi-Arabic, i-English, isi-French, isi-Turkish, ne-isi-Chinese; ayitholakali ngesiZulu. Amakhasi ngezinye izilimi achaza umkhiqizo ukuze uthole ulwazi kuphela.
strings.tierB.category.title: Isofthiwe yokuthengisa ngeveni (van sales) | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Isofthiwe yokuthengisa ngeveni nangemizila: ama-invoyisi aphrintwa ngefoni, isitoko seveni, izinkokhelo nokuvakasha. Isebenza noma kungekho nethiwekhi.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Isofthiwe yokuthengisa ngeveni yabasabalalisi nezinkampani zokuthengisa ngobuningi
strings.tierB.category.intro: I-FieldSales iyisofthiwe yokuthengisa ngeveni (van sales) yezinkampani ezinabathengisi abathengisa kusuka emotweni emizileni yansuku zonke. Umthengisi ulayisha iveni, athengise esitolo ngasinye, aphrinte i-invoyisi, aqoqe inkokhelo futhi abhale okubuyisiwe, konke nge-app eyodwa efonini. Umphathi ubona okulayishiwe, okuthengisiwe, imali eqoqiwe nokusele eveni ngayinye.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Iyini isofthiwe yokuthengisa ngeveni?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Isofthiwe yokuthengisa ngeveni, ebizwa nangokuthi isofthiwe yokuthengisa ngemizila (route sales), isebenzela indlela yokuthengisa lapho umthengisi ephethe isitoko emotweni, athengise, alethe impahla, akhiphe i-invoyisi futhi aqoqe imali ekuvakasheni okukodwa. Ithatha indawo yezincwadi zama-invoyisi zamaphepha nezingcingo zokuphela kosuku. Ibhala konke okuthengisiwe, inkokhelo ngayinye nokubuyisiwe njengedokhumenti, ukuze isitoko nemali kuqhathaniswe ngalo lolo suku. Kumphathi, iphendula imibuzo emithathu njalo kusihlwa: umthengisi ngamunye uthengiseni, uqoqeni, futhi kusaleni eveni ngayinye?
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Usuku lomthengisi emzileni
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Usuku luqala ngokulayishwa okubhaliwe kusuka endaweni yokugcina impahla kuya eveni. Esitolo ngasinye umthengisi uvula ikhasi lekhasimende ku-app, engeze imikhiqizo ngohlu noma ngebhakhodi, akhiphe i-invoyisi ayiphrinte ngephrinta ye-thermal. Inkokhelo ibhalwa ngerisidi, futhi noma yikuphi okubuyisiwe kubhalwa nesizathu sakho. Ekupheleni kosuku, okusele eveni kwehliselwa emuva endaweni yokugcina impahla. Phakathi kwalezi zinyathelo, umphathi angalandela okuthengiswe ngumthengisi ngamunye, imali ayiqoqile nokuvakasha kwakhe kudeshibhodi yewebhu ngaphandle kokushayela muntu ucingo.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Yakhelwe izindawo ezinesiginali esibuthakathaka
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Imizila yokusabalalisa idlula ezakhiweni ezingaphansi komhlaba, ezindaweni zezimboni nasemaphandleni lapho inethiwekhi ingekho kahle. I-app yabathengisi ye-FieldSales igcina amakhasimende, imikhiqizo namanani efonini, ukuze umthengisi akwazi ukukhipha nokuphrinta amadokhumenti ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Idokhumenti ngayinye inokhiye wayo ohlukile, ngakho ithunyelwa kanye kuphela, noma ukuthumela kuphindwa. Izinkampani zaseSaudi Arabia ezivule ukuxhumanisa kwama-invoyisi e-elekthronikhi zidinga uxhumano lwe-inthanethi ngesikhathi kukhishwa ama-invoyisi nokubuyisiwe. Kuzona, amarisidi, ukuvakasha namakhasimende amasha kusasebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Ukuqoqa imali nesitoko esiphethwe ngumthengisi
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Imali esemgwaqweni idinga ukulawulwa okufanayo nokwesitoko. Yonke imali eqoqiwe ithola irisidi elinenombolo elingaxhunywa kuma-invoyisi akhokhelwayo, futhi ibhalansi yekhasimende ibuyekezwa ngokushesha. Isitoko seveni sibalwa ngomkhiqizo ngamunye: okulayishiwe kususwe okuthengisiwe, kwengezwe okubuyisiwe nokulungiswa okubhaliwe, ukuze abaphathi bakwazi ukusiqhathanisa nokubalwa kwangempela ngaphambi kokuba umthengisi agoduke. Okubuyisiwe kungahlukaniswa njengokujwayelekile, okonakele noma okushintshwayo, futhi umphathi unquma ukuthi impahla ebuyisiwe ibuyela yini esitokweni seveni esilungele ukuthengiswa.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Yenzelwe obani?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: I-FieldSales ifanele abasabalalisi nezinkampani zokuthengisa ngobuningi zempahla ethengiswa ngokushesha (FMCG) njengokudla, iziphuzo, imikhiqizo yokuhlanza neyokuzinakekela, kanye nanoma iyiphi inkampani enabathengisi abavakashela izitolo emizileni, kuhlanganise nezitolo zasemalokishini nama-spaza. Isekela ukuthengisa ngeveni, ukuthatha ama-oda kusengaphambili (pre-sales) nokulethwa ngqo ezitolo (DSD). Ayiyona i-ERP ephelele: ixhumana nohlelo lwakho lwe-accounting noma lwe-ERP nge-API. Abaphathi balawula lokho umthengisi ngamunye angakwenza, njengokunikeza izaphulelo, ukuthengisa ngaphansi kwenani lohlu noma ukwengeza amakhasimende amasha.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Uyini umehluko phakathi kokuthengisa ngeveni nokuthatha ama-oda kusengaphambili (pre-sales)?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Ekuthengiseni ngeveni umthengisi uphatha isitoko, alethe, akhiphe i-invoyisi futhi aqoqe imali ekuvakasheni okufanayo. Ku-pre-sales umthengisi uthatha i-oda elizolethwa yindawo yokugcina impahla kamuva. I-FieldSales isekela zombili, ngakho inkampani ingathengisa ngeveni kweminye imizila futhi ithathe ama-oda kweminye. Kuzo zombili izindlela, ama-invoyisi, imali eqoqiwe namabhalansi amakhasimende kusohlelweni olulodwa, futhi abaphathi bakubona emibikweni efanayo.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Ngisibhalansa kanjani isitoko seveni ekupheleni kosuku?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: I-FieldSales ikhombisa, kumkhiqizo ngamunye eveni ngayinye, ubuningi obulayishiwe, obuthengisiwe, obubuyisiwe nobusele. Qhathanisa isibalo esisele nokubalwa kwangempela, bhala noma yimuphi umehluko njengokulungiswa okubhaliwe, bese wehlisela okusele endaweni yokugcina impahla ngesinyathelo esisodwa. Iveni iqala usuku olulandelayo nebhalansi ehlanzekile eyaziwayo.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Umthengisi othengisa ngeveni udinga yimiphi imishini?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: I-smartphone, i-Android noma i-iPhone. Iphrinta ye-thermal esebenza nge-Bluetooth ayiphoqelekile; isiza umthengisi ukuthi anikeze ikhasimende i-invoyisi ephrintiwe noma irisidi. I-FieldSales ayithengisi imishini futhi ayidingi uhlobo oluthile lwephrinta. Abaphathi basebenzisa ideshibhodi yewebhu kunoma yisiphi isiphequluli sekhompyutha noma sefoni.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: Ingabe i-FieldSales ingaxhunywa nohlelo lwethu lwe-accounting?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Yebo. I-FieldSales inikeza i-API eyenza uhlelo lwakho lwe-accounting noma lwe-ERP lukwazi ukushintshisana neplatifomu ngedatha yamakhasimende, imikhiqizo, ama-invoyisi, amarisidi nokuhamba kwesitoko. Ithimba lakho noma umhlinzeki wakho we-IT yibo abakha ukuxhumanisa besebenzisa imibhalo ye-API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales ngezwe: imali, intela ne-e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: I-FieldSales isebenzela abasabalalisi kuwo wonke amazwe. Bona uhlobo lwemali, intela nesimo se-e-invoicing ezweni ngalinye ethebulini elilodwa.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: I-FieldSales yakhelwe izinkampani zokusabalalisa emhlabeni wonke. Inkampani ngayinye ikhetha izwe layo, uhlobo lwemali nezinga lentela kuzilungiselelo zayo, futhi ama-invoyisi, amarisidi nemibiko kulandela lokho. Ukuxhumanisa nezinhlelo zikahulumeni zama-invoyisi e-elekthronikhi kusebenza eSaudi Arabia kuphela. Kuwo wonke amanye amazwe kutholakala uma kuceliwe. Ithebula elingezansi likhombisa, ezweni ngalinye, uhlobo lwemali yendawo, izinga elijwayelekile lentela yokuthengisa noma i-VAT, nokuthi ukuxhumanisa nezinhlelo zikahulumeni zama-invoyisi e-elekthronikhi kuyasebenza noma kutholakala uma kuceliwe.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Sisekela ukuxhumanisa kweSigaba Sesibili neplatifomu ye-Fatoora ye-ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Uhlobo lwemali nezinga lentela kusethwa yinkampani ngayinye kuzilungiselelo zayo. Amazinga akuleli thebula ayisiqondiso esijwayelekile futhi angashintsha; buza umeluleki wakho wentela ngemithetho yamanje. Udeshi (—) lusho ukuthi alikho izinga elijwayelekile elibhalwe kulelo zwe.
strings.tierB.about.title: Mayelana ne-FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: I-FieldSales yakha isofthiwe ye-cloud yezinkampani zokusabalalisa ezinabathengisi abavakashela amakhasimende. Yasungulwa ngo-2026 eRiyadh, eSaudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: I-FieldSales (igama lesi-Arabhu: فيلد سيلز) iyiplatifomu ye-cloud yezinkampani zokusabalalisa nezithengisa ngobuningi ezinabathengisi abavakashela amakhasimende. Inkampani yasungulwa ngo-2026 futhi izinze eRiyadh, eSaudi Arabia. Isebenzela izinkampani kuwo wonke amazwe, kanti uhlobo lwemali nezinga lentela lezwe ngalinye kusethwa kuzilungiselelo zenkampani uqobo. Amakhasimende ethu yizinkampani ezithengisa futhi zilethe impahla ngabathengisi abahamba imizila: abasabalalisi, izinkampani zokuthengisa ngobuningi nabakhiqizi abanabathengisi babo abathengisa ngamaveni.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Sakha uhlelo olulodwa oluxhumene lomjikelezo wonke womsebenzi wasemizileni: ama-invoyisi aphrintwa kusuka efonini yomthengisi, amarisidi namabhalansi amakhasimende, isitoko seveni esiphethwe ngumthengisi, imizila nokuvakasha okubhalwa nendawo nezithombe, kanye nedeshibhodi yewebhu yabaphathi. I-app yabathengisi isebenza ku-Android naku-iPhone futhi iqhubeka isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, bese ivumelanisa lapho uxhumano lubuya. Izinkampani zingaxhuma i-FieldSales nohlelo lwazo lwe-accounting noma lwe-ERP nge-API, ukuze kungadingeki ukuthi idatha yasemizileni ithayiphwe kabili.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Sichaza umkhiqizo njengoba unjalo. Sisekela ukuxhumanisa kweSigaba Sesibili neplatifomu ye-Fatoora ye-ZATCA. Ukuxhumanisa nezinhlelo zikahulumeni kwamanye amazwe kutholakala uma kuceliwe. I-app itholakala kulezi zilimi: isi-Arabic, i-English, isi-French, isi-Turkish, ne-isi-Chinese; ayitholakali ngesiZulu. Ukuze ukhulume nathi, cela ikhotheshini, bhuka umhlangano noma usithumelele umlayezo ku-WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Xhumana ne-FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Khuluma nethimba le-FieldSales: cela ikhotheshini, bhuka umhlangano noma uxoxe nathi ku-WhatsApp ngesofthiwe yabathengisi neyokuthengisa ngeveni.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Sitshele ukuthi abathengisi bakho bathengisa kanjani namuhla nokuthi yini ofuna ukuyishintsha. Cela ikhotheshini, bhuka umhlangano noma usithumelele umlayezo ku-WhatsApp, futhi ilungu lethimba lethu lizokuphendula. Amakhasimende akhona angasebenzisa zona lezi zindlela ukuthola usizo. Kuyasiza uma usho izwe lakho, isibalo sabathengisi nokuthi bathengisa ngamaveni, bathatha ama-oda noma kokubili.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Bhuka umhlangano ku-inthanethi nethimba lethu. Sizokukhombisa usuku lomthengisi ku-app kanye nedeshibhodi yomphathi, sisebenzisa izibonelo eziseduze nemikhiqizo yakho nemizila yakho, futhi siphendule imibuzo yakho mayelana nokuhlela.
